02 — THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECTS

Curiosity first.
Craft follows.

I’m Tarun Tej, a web developer, Python programmer and AI/ML enthusiast based in Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh, India.

I’ve been learning web development since 2022 and working with Python since 2023. My projects connect interactive interfaces with the mathematics and engineering underneath: neural networks, exact arithmetic, storage and reproducible practice tools.

Alongside building, I evaluate AI-generated responses and code against task-specific rubrics. I’m interested in web and software development, Python projects, AI/ML learning opportunities, and AI evaluation roles.
